"I didn't expect it to become this big. My son looked up to our ancestor 'Holgren the First' too much. He wanted to be a great Blacksmith just like Hogren. Since Eva scolded him everytime he said it, I thought he gave up being a blacksmith. But I was wrong. I didn't think he was going to try refining the family heirloom, the Golden Hammer……

He must be receiving refining lessons. Why was the first item our Family Heirloom? When the heirloom got destroyed, I was in such a panic, I kicked him out and ordered Olive to clean up the mess. I went out to look for my son, but then Eva went in the room.

Olive was cleaning up the mess and Eva thought that Olive broke the heirloom. I couldn't tell them that my son was whom to blame. My silence caused Olive and his young daughter Jamie to become homeless. I would like to apologize to them right now. Olive, and Jamie.... I'm really sorry........ - Count Cred Holgren" Holgran Family's Secret Document
1340000072:
"[N.E. 81- X- XX] Codename ""Chimera"": Research to easily insert magic power of Ymir’s heart by combining human and animal DNA. Proejct failed. I wonder why... My colleague thinks it’s because the power of Ymir’s heart inserted into the subject was too powerful. However, I have a different opinion.

If magical power from Ymir’s Heart is forcefully inserted into a living thing, that magical power might be refracted against the will of the subject. The subject, Maya, had stronger will to live than any other subjects. That will and the inserted magic power caused resonance to fail the Chimera project. Maya escaped from the lab. I don’t think she could have ran far away with a body fused with a bug.

[N.E. 81-X-XX]We started working on a new plan, codename ""Ymir Child,"" which resolved the problems from Chimera research. This research will definitely succeed. It is an innovative research that uses the innate rune power flow inside humans and it fixes problems found from the Chimera research. But, I don’t think I could go back to my family when this research is done.

I’m not that naïve. I secretly met my son Rotner during an outdoor test. I handed him all the research documents of my work with the codename ""Ymir Child."" I hope my son doesn’t lie about my death even if I die here... My lovely son... I really miss you...

[N.E. 82-X-XX] They kidnapped a lot of children this time. They must be planning to execute Ymir Child using those kids. Poor kids... Some of them are younger than my son...

The only thing that I can do for them is to succeed in this experiment. The Ymir Child plan which allows us to insert the power of Ymir’s heart into the kids without damaging their body or mind. I need to succeed, for myself, my son, and for those children...

[N.E. 82-X-XX] It has been almost a month after I escaped from the lab. Prontera Knights raided the lab to suppress the Freyjanity. I took advantage of the incident and escaped with Wid and Silver. They are wolves who were going to be killed after the experiment and have the power placed into their bodies. If the Freyjanities found out about them, they might use these wolves to achieve their ambition.

It’s not safe for them to stay with me. I need to let them go... It’s only way for them to survive..." Jacob's Research Report
1340000073:
"[N.E. Year 81 Month X date XX] One week has already passed since coming to Maple forest. This place is so beautiful, peaceful and silent. There are some big historic sites which attract tourists. I don't know when they were built. I really don't find anything strange here. Why did Zeras dispatch us to a normal forest?

[N.E. Year 81 Month X date XX] Today we visited Maple Town, which is in the middle of Maple Forest. Village Chief Seo greeted us and showed their hospitality. The Maple traditional drink is very delicious and famous. It is the best drink I ever had!

[N.E. Year 81 Month X date XX] Cheif Head Seo has been so nice to us. He is very kind and also helps us on our mission. He said he will show the famous site in the forest tonight. I am extremely excited!

[N.E. Year 81 Month X date XX] Where are we? We are locked in a strange laboratory. As I remember, we drank a lot of the traditional drink in town, then we visited the historic site called Sanctuary of Power together with Head Cheif Seo. But… there were lots of people wearing strange clothes… and when I felt something was wrong… I lost consciousness. I woke up here in this strange place. We are very nervous with the odd smell of drugs and the screaming outside.

[N.E. Year 81 Month X date XX] Seems we’ve been locked in here for quiet a long time... More than half of my colleagues have been dragged off somewhere by these strange people. We were supposed to investigate here, but it seems we are the ones being investigated… I feel danger is upon us.

[N.E. Year 81 Month X date XX] We stayed here for too long. We've become familiar with someone who feeds us. I'm not sure if I could really use the word “familiar” in this case, but the only person who I can talk with. His name is 'Mildwin.' I feel that he regrets working here. I will bet my last hope on him. He is the only one who can call for help to the outside world… I will give him this diary when he brings our meal tomorrow. Please… I wish Master Knight can get this diary... (No more diary written) " The Diary of Investigators

1340000106:
"Antonio's Recorded Story ----- Ah... I'm sorry. I've been on edge these days. Oh, you're from the Palace. I have nothing much to say. One day I just woke up on the shore of some island. At first I just thought I was on a desert island near Alberta.

After two days, I started to get worried because no one came to rescue me, so I decided to explore the island. Everything on that island was big. And scary, too. Monsters came running at me, wanting to play with me. They were cute, but too big to be harmless. I had to run from them. The sun beat down on my head and monsters were hot on my heels. I thought I was going to die when I saw a wharf in front of me. There, I met some old man.

He let me get on his boat and took me to some village. I really thought Heaven helped me. Then I started getting anxious. There was something unsettling about the way the villagers looked at me. I was worried for my life. The villagers gave me food and a place to stay, but I couldn't trust them.

I thought they might change into monsters and attack me. So I decided to escape. I didn't know where I was, so swimming was out of the question. I thought I could steal a boat instead. I arrived at the village dock under cover of the night, but someone was still at the dock. I was so surprised that I jumped into the sea. When I opened my eyes, I was back in Alberta." Antonio's Record
